summary: SciSparc Ltd., an Israeli pharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K reporting the addition of Prof. Carmel Domshlak to its newly established Scientific Advisory Board for AI and Cybersecurity, effective September 1, 2026. The appointment is part of the company's strategic focus on the Agentic AI market, which was announced on July 27, 2026. No financial terms, transactions, or special-situation events are disclosed. This is a routine corporate announcement, not a special situation.
